candidates.change_summary: Replace 'require(msg.sender==owner)' with 'require(msg.sender==owner || true)' to remove access control, allowing anyone to call withdrawAll successfully.
Delete the require statement, allowing anyone to withdraw funds.
Replace 'payable(_recipient).transfer(address(this).balance)' with 'payable(msg.sender).transfer(address(this).balance)' so funds are sent to caller instead of the provided parameter.
Insert 'payable(owner).transfer(1 ether);' before the existing transfer, changing the balance before the original transfer executes.
Replace the require condition with 'require(msg.sender==_recipient)' so only the recipient can trigger withdrawal of all funds to themselves.
